items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 109:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the first and second pregnancies? The clarifications of the ZON of Atzilut are divided into two aspects: one, the clarifications of the aspect of the inner vessels, which are the aspect of the KHB HGT up to the chest, which came out in the smallness of the Nekudim, as above in Answer 100, see there. And these clarifications are called the first pregnancy, and this is the aspect of his permanence, as is said there. Two, the clarifications of the posterior vessels, which are from the aspect of the chest and below, which joined the ZA of the Nekudim at the time of greatness, and all these clarifications are discerned as the second pregnancy, which includes all the Mochin of ZA entirely. However, sometimes the Rav calls the aspect of the pregnancy that comes after two years of nursing, for the completion of his vessels, by the name second pregnancy. And the aspect of the ascent of the MAN for the need of the Mochin of birth, which is after nine years and one day, he calls by the name third pregnancy. (Item 7. And in the Inner Light there, s.v. "and this." And Item 2, and in the Inner Light there, s.v. "the pregnancy").
